description: Get the ready-to-paste Sellular badge embed for one of the connected account's products, as HTML (also valid JSX as-is) and as Markdown. One embed per product: the image auto-upgrades to whichever tier the product currently holds (listed, editor's pick, top rated, or the paid featured slot while it runs), so it is pasted once and never replaced; never pin a width on it. The badge's link resolves per click too: the product's featured article while a paid feature window runs, its page in the Sellular directory otherwise, where visitors read and leave reviews. The tool itself edits nothing: if you are an agent working inside the product's source repository, add the snippet to the landing page header or footer yourself, next to any other trust badges, keeping the link and alt text intact; otherwise hand it to the developer. Account-scoped: requires the MCP_API_KEY bearer token.

product.description: Product name or domain to look up (substring match). Optional when the account has one active product.

name: get_listing_badge
